sources.title: Piracy monthly report December 2025
sources.text: While underway two sampans were sighted alongside the towing barge and about 15 to 20 perpetrators were onboard the barge. The perpetrators then left the barge with some scrap metals. All crew members were accounted for with no injuries and no assistance required. The master immediately reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) Central. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance.
